answer: The willow of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Work waits on the knoll until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the dawn of the next round. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work.
